episodes.summary: The remaining home chefs face the hardest challenge yet in this scrumptious celebration of MasterChef's 250th episode! The kitchen heats up when the chef with immunity is tasked to assign each contestant with an iconic cake to recreate.

episodes.title: Dodgers Stadium Field Challenge
episodes.summary: The chefs split into two teams to prepare a lunch for over 100 kids at Dodger Stadium, and the chef with immunity gets to choose one member from each team who must swap sides and work with the other regions.

episodes.title: Military Rations Mystery Box
episodes.summary: In this week's challenge, the Mystery Box is back and the chefs must individually face the challenge of preparing a gourmet meal out of army rations.

episodes.title: Tag Team
episodes.summary: The remaining home chefs must tackle a classic MasterChef test: the tag team challenge. The contestants must take turns preparing a delicious three course meal, working together to ensure they are on the same page every step of the way.

episodes.title: Fish Out of Water Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The chefs face their toughest Mystery Box challenge yet - fish! When the chefs with immunity are able to switch up the other contestants' fish, the competition starts to fire up.

episodes.title: Kelsey's Stadium Food
episodes.summary: The contestants must cater to the average sports fan while incorporating elements from their region to elevate their dish, and the chef with immunity is tasked with giving a penalty to the home cook of their choosing to receive a five-minute timeout.

episodes.title: Patio Grilling Challenge
episodes.summary: The remaining nine home cooks are tasked with firing up their grills and preparing a restaurant quality barbecue plate that is guaranteed to impress the judges.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.summary: The chefs face their biggest challenge yet: a 55-foot wall. The chef with immunity is tasked with pairing contestants to cook on opposite sides of the wall, where they must rely on great communication in order to save themselves from a double elimination.

episodes.title: Restaurant Takeover - Hell's Kitchen
episodes.summary: With Gordon Ramsay's reputation on the line, the top six chefs face the ultimate challenge of taking over the world's largest Hell's Kitchen restaurant.

episodes.title: Semi-Finals: Pasta & Keeping Up With Gordon
episodes.summary: The remaining five home cooks take on two rounds of challenges that determine who will move on to the Finals.

episodes.title: Finale Part One
episodes.summary: The final three home cooks take on their last challenge in the MasterChef kitchen in front of a live audience. Each chef has to whip up a spectacular three-course meal, knowing only one deliberation stands between them and the $250,000 prize.

episodes.title: Finale Part Two
episodes.summary: Judges Gordon Ramsay, Aarón Sánchez and Joe Bastianich crown the next MasterChef champion.

episodes.title: Millennials Auditions
episodes.summary: The millennial chefs prepare their signature dishes for the judges; Priya Krishna guest judges.

episodes.title: Baby Boomers Auditions
episodes.summary: The auditions continue as the Baby Boomer chefs battle it out for a spot in the top 20.

episodes.title: Gen Z Auditions
episodes.summary: Gen Z chefs prepare a signature dish.

episodes.title: Gen X Auditions
episodes.summary: The auditions conclude as the Gen X chefs take over the kitchen. Each contestant has 45 minutes to prepare a signature dish that will impress the judges and secure one of the final five spots in the competition.

episodes.title: Back to the Future - Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The four generations go head-to-head as the top 20 enter the MasterChef kitchen. The chefs are faced with their first mystery box challenge where they are presented with a childhood photo of themselves and tasked with creating a restaurant-worthy dish that highlights their favorite nostalgic comfort foods from their youth. The most impressive dish grants an entire generation immunity from elimination while a chef from the remaining three teams risks going home.

episodes.title: Age is Just a Number
episodes.summary: The multigenerational chefs are tasked with creating a stunning dish using a variety of aged and fermented ingredients. With the safety of an immunity pin, the winner of last week's challenge chooses a generation to incorporate a surprise ingredient into their dishes. The chef with the best dish will earn an immunity pin and protect the remaining chefs within their generation from elimination.

episodes.title: LAFC Field Challenge
episodes.summary: The four generations are split into teams as they take on their first field challenge - cooking a healthy and hearty meal for professional soccer players. The chefs must work together to cook over 100 portions of food and the pressure intensifies as the generations collide. Both teams compete head-to-head in hopes of scoring a win and earning the safety from elimination.

episodes.title: Birthday Bakes
episodes.summary: The chefs turn to their baking skills when tasked with making a celebratory birthday cake.

episodes.title: Memory Lane - Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The chefs work in teams to create a dish using a mystery box filled with different food items from their generation.

episodes.title: Beer Necessities
episodes.summary: The chefs must incorporate the iconic beer, Blue Moon, into their dishes and ensure that the bright flavors are at the forefront of their creations.

episodes.title: Quarry Field Challenge
episodes.summary: The chefs take on another field challenge as they are tasked with cooking a hearty lunch for over 100 workers.

episodes.title: Tag Team
episodes.summary: The twelve remaining chefs work in pairs and switch off cooking back-and-forth during the infamous tag team challenge.

episodes.title: Storm's a Brewin'
episodes.summary: The contestants are given only 45 minutes to prepare a restaurant quality dish that features coffee, and Chef Gordon Ramsay kicks off the challenge with a demonstration of his own espresso-infused dish.

episodes.title: Feel the Burn - Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The MasterChef kitchen heats up as the top ten contestants are faced with a fiery mystery box challenge!

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.summary: Later on, the top eight chefs face an unexpected surprise and discover that they must work in pairs to cook identical dishes from opposite sides of a wall.

episodes.title: Ramsay's Rooftop Restaurant Takeover
episodes.summary: The top six home chefs get a break from the MasterChef kitchen to take over Ramsay's Rooftop, an exclusive pop-up restaurant open for one night only in the heart of Downtown Los Angeles.

episodes.title: Semi Final
episodes.summary: The top five chefs face two back-to-back challenges involving a mystery box and replicating a restaurant quality dish.

episodes.title: Finale Part One
episodes.summary: The top three chefs must create a three-course meal, starting with an awe-inspiring appetizer.

episodes.title: Finale Part Two
episodes.summary: The chefs must create entrée and dessert courses that highlight their backgrounds and skill sets.

episodes.title: The Audition Battles
episodes.summary: Eight pairs of home cooks go head-to-head fighting to win legendary white aprons.

episodes.title: The Audition Battles Continue
episodes.summary: The remaining eight pairs of home cooks go head-to-head in the audition battles.

episodes.title: Second Chance Battles
episodes.summary: The duos who failed to get white aprons in the audition rounds, get a surprise second chance.

episodes.title: Dinner Party Dish
episodes.summary: The top 12 duos must impress the judges with their finest dinner party dish.

episodes.title: Mister-y & Mrs. Box
episodes.summary: The Top 11 duos must combine two boxes of ingredients to make a harmonious dish.

episodes.title: Pier Pressure
episodes.summary: The Top 10 duos, in a stunning pier-side setting, must feed over 100 local fishermen and women.

episodes.title: Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The five duos on the losing team from the previous challenge face the first pressure test.

episodes.title: Recipe Telephone
episodes.summary: One teammate begins cooking and the other must complete the dish.

episodes.title: Train to Table
episodes.summary: Two teams must prepare a VIP dining experience aboard a moving steam train.

episodes.title: The Great Ingredient Bid Off
episodes.summary: The four duos on the losing team last week fight for survival in a new pressure test challenge; the duos must bid for their ingredients, but they must give up time instead of money to get their preferred ingredients.

episodes.title: Macaron Mayhem
episodes.summary: The duos must bake not just a dozen macarons, but a giant tower of perfectly formed delicacies.

episodes.title: Backyard BBQ
episodes.summary: The duos are split into two teams and must serve a garden full of barbecue aficionados.

episodes.title: Divide & Conquer
episodes.summary: Each duo is challenged to create a three-course meal that replicates an appetizer from Joe Bastianich's restaurant, an entree from Tiffany Derry's restaurant and a dessert from Gordon Ramsay's restaurant.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.summary: Both cooks in each duo must make the exact same dish while divided by an eight-foot-high wall, communicating by shouting over it; the duos must ensure their dish looks and tastes the same; the pair who make the worst dish are eliminated.

episodes.title: Keeping Up With Gordon - Tag Team Style!
episodes.summary: The top four duos face their biggest test yet in the semifinal challenge in which they must attempt to make one of Gordon's Michelin star dishes at the same speed as he makes it while taking turns cooking.

episodes.title: Road to the Finale
episodes.summary: In honor of the lead up to the finale, FOX celebrates the highs and lows of season fifteen. In a compilation of clip highlights, the finalists will be showcased.

episodes.title: Grand Finale, Part 1
episodes.summary: The Top 3 duos face their last, most intimidating night of cooking in the MasterChef kitchen for the Grand Finale. With an audience of friends and family, and the judges studying their every move, tonight the duos must perform their very best as a pair.

episodes.title: Grand Finale, Part 2
episodes.summary: The Top 3 duos face their last, most intimidating night of cooking in the MasterChef kitchen for the Grand Finale. With an audience of friends and family, and the judges studying their every move, tonight the duos must perform their very best as a pair.

episodes.title: Auditions Day 1 (Europe)
episodes.summary: Eight home cooks kick off the audition rounds inspired by Europe, as flavors and traditions from across the continent take center stage.

episodes.title: Auditions Day 2 (Asia-Pacific)
episodes.summary: Eight home cooks compete to represent their heritage from the Asia-Pacific region in the audition battles.

episodes.title: Auditions Day 3 (Africa)
episodes.summary: The audition rounds continue with eight new home cooks facing off for a chance to represent Africa.

episodes.title: Auditions Day 4 (The Americas)
episodes.summary: It's the last round of auditions, and home cooks from the Americas vie for a chance to earn a white apron.

episodes.title: Game Day Gourmet
episodes.summary: Standout home cooks from the audition rounds face off in a World Cup-inspired challenge to create elevated versions of classic stadium foods infused with their own cultural flair.

episodes.title: Eggs Benedict
episodes.summary: Each contestant must let their culture shine by creating a unique take on eggs Benedict; a second immunity pin is on the line; one team is saddled with a major disadvantage that could cost them everything.

episodes.title: Team Pitch to Plate
episodes.summary: In the season's first team challenge, chefs compete to see who will make the starting lineup, trading in their mystery ingredients for a chance to score big; coach Mauricio Pochettino makes a guest appearance.

episodes.title: World Cup Cookoff
episodes.summary: The kitchen is transformed into a backyard barbecue, where the cooks must step up and prove that they can take their country's game time cravings to the next level.

episodes.title: Bitter Sweet Mystery Box
episodes.summary: The home cooks must create chocolate confections inspired by their heritage.

episodes.title: Wheel of Fusion
episodes.summary: The top 14 home cooks must work with unfamiliar ingredients and techniques to create a successful fusion dish; as the judges sample their way around the world, only one team will come out on top and earn an immunity pin.

episodes.title: Royal Wedding
episodes.summary: The Top 12 home cooks head to a grand castle to cater the MasterChef Royal Wedding of Season 15 winners Jesse and Jessica. With 50 guests deciding their fate, the teams must deliver a feast worthy of the crown. In the end, not every fairytale gets a happy ending as one team finds themselves at risk of elimination.

episodes.title: Global Feed
episodes.summary: Celebrity chef, social media icon, and past MasterChef contestant Nick DiGiovanni joins as a special guest to test the chefs' ability to turn their cultural roots into the next viral food sensation. With an exciting collaboration opportunity with DiGiovanni on the line, the contestants must strike the perfect balance between authenticity and social media appeal.

episodes.title: Tag Team
episodes.summary: The remaining home cooks compete in pairs as they race to recreate dishes inspired by the judges' most cherished culinary memories; in the end, one team's journey comes to an end with a double elimination.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.summary: Separated by an eight-foot barrier, the home cooks must partner up and rely solely on communication to create identical dishes; a double elimination.

episodes.title: Restaurant Takeover
episodes.summary: Tonight, the Top 6 home cooks are split into teams to put their skills to the ultimate test and take over Cluny Bistro for a packed dinner service in the Restaurant Takeover challenge. The MasterChef kitchen has prepared them for this moment, but running a real restaurant leaves no room for error. By the end of the night, one cook will not survive the dinner rush.

episodes.title: Keeping Up With Gordon and Tiffany
episodes.summary: Tonight, the top five home cooks battle for a place in the finale by keeping up with Chefs Gordon Ramsay and Tiffany Derry as they recreate their signature dishes in real time. Falling behind isn't an option as only three cooks will advance.

episodes.title: Finale Part 1
episodes.summary: The top three home cooks face their biggest challenge yet in the MasterChef Grand Finale. With friends, family, and a packed audience cheering them on, and the judges watching every move, the finalists must deliver the performance of their lives. Tasked with creating an exceptional three-course menu inspired by their roots, every plate must meet the judges' exacting standards as they compete for the coveted title of America's MasterChef, and the $250,000 grand prize.

episodes.title: Finale Part 2
episodes.summary: The MasterChef finale continues as the finalists present dishes inspired by their journeys through the Global Gauntlet, showcasing the culinary skills and perspectives that brought them to this moment. With the competition nearing an end, every detail matters as they craft their most remarkable dishes in a final bid to impress the judges.
